user_query: I want to organize a charity event with uplifting music, a trivia fact, and a motivational track from Deezer.

TaskList.description: Search for a playlist containing inspirational and uplifting tracks suitable for a charity event.
Retrieve a random trivia fact to share with participants.
Get a random motivational track from Deezer to play during the event.

dependencies.description: The playlist information from task 1 can be used to select or confirm the motivational track from Deezer.
